## Methodology & Provenance
CryptoCasinoMedia Local metrics are compiled weekly from the Google Trends public dataset on BigQuery across 50 U.S. states and ~210 Nielsen Designated Market Areas (DMAs). All index scores measure relative local attention on a 0-100 scale.
